description: MCP server for Zotero 10+. Read and write your library entirely offline through Zotero's native local API. No plugin, no API key, no cloud.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_add_items_to_collection
tool_signatures.description: File existing items into a collection, keeping every collection they already belong to. An item in Zotero can sit in any number of collections, so this adds rather than moves. Items already in the collection are reported as unchanged and cost no write.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_attach_file
tool_signatures.description: Attach a file from disk to a Zotero item, or add it as a standalone attachment. mode=

tool_signatures.name: zotero_create_collection
tool_signatures.description: Create one or more collections, optionally nested under an existing collection. Up to 50 per call. Creating a nested tree takes one call per level, since a child needs its parent\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_create_items
tool_signatures.description: Create up to 50 items in one call. Set

tool_signatures.name: zotero_delete_collection
tool_signatures.description: Move collections to Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_delete_items
tool_signatures.description: Move up to 50 items to Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_empty_trash
tool_signatures.description: Permanently erase every item in the trash. This is irreversible and removes attachment files from disk. As an interlock against emptying a trash the caller has not looked at, expectedCount must equal the number of items actually in it: call zotero_list_trash first and pass its totalResults. If the two disagree the call is refused and nothing is deleted. Only use this when the user has explicitly asked to empty the trash.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_export_items
tool_signatures.description: Export items in a citation format. Use format

tool_signatures.name: zotero_get_attachment_path
tool_signatures.description: Resolve an attachment to its absolute path on this machine, so the file can be opened and read directly. Works for both linked and imported attachments. Passing a regular item key returns the paths of all of its file attachments. Use this to read a PDF whose text Zotero has not indexed.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_get_collection
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one collection by key, including its name, parent collection, item count and current version. The version is what zotero_update_collection and zotero_delete_collection use for conflict detection.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_get_item
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one item by key with all of its metadata. Set includeChildren to also return its notes and attachments, which is the quickest way to find the attachment key needed to read a PDF or its full text.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_get_item_children
tool_signatures.description: List the child notes, attachments and annotations of an item. Attachment children carry the linkMode and filename needed by zotero_get_attachment_path and zotero_get_item_fulltext.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_get_item_fulltext
tool_signatures.description: Return the indexed full text of an attachment. Passing a regular item key works too: its attachments are searched and the first one with indexed text is used. Text comes from Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_list_collections
tool_signatures.description: List collections in a library. scope=

tool_signatures.name: zotero_list_saved_searches
tool_signatures.description: List the saved searches defined in the library, with their conditions. Run one with zotero_run_saved_search. Note that the local API can actually execute saved searches, which the zotero.org web API cannot.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_list_tags
tool_signatures.description: List tags in the library, optionally only those used within one collection or matching a search. Useful for discovering how a library is organized before filtering zotero_search_items by tag.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_list_trash
tool_signatures.description: List the items currently in Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_remove_items_from_collection
tool_signatures.description: Remove items from one collection. The items stay in the library and in any other collection they belong to; nothing is deleted. Items that were not in the collection are reported as unchanged.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_restore_collection
tool_signatures.description: Bring collections back out of Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_restore_items
tool_signatures.description: Bring items back out of Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_run_saved_search
tool_signatures.description: Execute a saved search and return the matching items. The search runs against the local database using Zotero\

tool_signatures.name: zotero_search_items
tool_signatures.description: Search the local Zotero library.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_update_collection
tool_signatures.description: Rename a collection and/or move it under a different parent. Pass parentCollectionKey=null to move a collection to the root of the library. The current version is fetched automatically unless expectedVersion is given, in which case the write fails with a conflict if the collection changed in the meantime.

tool_signatures.name: zotero_update_item
tool_signatures.description: Patch fields on an existing item. Only the fields passed in
